about.title: About Semak Dulu
about.subtitle: A scam-awareness tool that helps you stop, check, and act safely.
about.purposeBody: Semak Dulu helps Malaysians pause and check a suspicious message, link, phone number, or screenshot before acting. It is built around a simple model: STOP, CHECK, ACT.
about.howIntro: Every check produces a risk level, a score, warning signs, and next steps. Two paths can produce this result:
about.howAi: When an AI connection is available, your message is analysed to give richer explanations in your chosen language.
about.howFallback: When there is no AI or you are offline, a built-in rule-based engine still produces a complete, explainable result. The Check feature works fully without internet.
about.howNote: AI is never a hard requirement. Check always works, even without a connection.
about.privacyBody: Semak Dulu runs inside your browser with no backend database and no login. We do not store IC numbers, bank details, or OTPs. Only preferences such as language, quiz score, and your family list are saved locally on your device, and they are never sent to any server.
about.disclaimerBody: Semak Dulu is an awareness and decision-support tool. It is not a guarantee and does not replace official advice. Always verify directly through official channels.
about.emergencyIntro: If you are targeted or fall victim to a scam, get official numbers from official sources only. Do not use a number given in a suspicious message or call.
about.emergencyStep1: Call the official national scam response helpline.
about.emergencyStep2: Contact your bank through their official channels (the number on the back of your card or their official website).
about.emergencyStep3: Make a report at your nearest police station.
about.emergencyStep4: Verify every phone number directly from the relevant agency's official website.
about.emergencyNote: We do not display any official number here because a wrong number can create new risk. Please refer to official sources for the current numbers.
